notes.title: Dev News #2
notes.notes:
Hi Folks.  It's 2020, and Miner Lou development continues!

It's been a month since the last update and I wanted to make a quick post about development progress on two main areas I'm focused on: Game Controller Support & the upcomming Content Expansion. 

[h3]Game Controller Support[/h3]
Game Controller support is almost ready, I've been methodically going through Miner Lou's UI elements and adding support for the new controller input system.  It's working pretty well so far and will be available soon!

It will automatically detect if you push any controller button and switch to "controller mode".  In this mode you can navigate the UI and game using the D-pad, Analog Axis Inputs, and button/triggers.  Just about any standard game controller should work!

Controller support will be fully available in beta hopefully within a week, and soon after on the public branch.  Controller support is really important to me and I'll continue to tweak as needed.

[h3]Storied Expansion DLC[/h3]
The upcomming expansion will include Story Mode and several new Arcade Mode Levels.  There are new characters, new enemies, new boss fights.  

[h3]Maps with gaps or holes[/h3]
Maps can now have gaps or holes in them.  With the changes I can make more varied shaped maps or even maps with a large hole in the middle.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790954/7ea5e4fdc031b0a526870950fd6e41f02ad9ad38.png[/img]

notes.title: Enemy Speed Reworked, LOS Changes, Gem Stats UI added (0.279)
notes.notes:
Hello Folks.  In this update I've reworked the way enemy speed is calculated and added some Line of Sight changes to Gem Towers and Rocks.   I've also added Gem Tower stats to the selected tower UI panel.

[h1]Selected Gem Stats[/h1]

The selected gem now also shows its attack power and main ability cooldown.  If buffed (or debuffed) it will show the amount of the buff in red or green text.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790954/bcadb53d1d2bdb2276012c52f269db3d5f22c188.gif[/img]

[h1]Speed Changes[/h1]

You'll notice the mid levels enemies will be a bit slower over all and at the very high rounds (60+) they will be quite fast but will not reach the excessive speeds they were previously!

At excessively high speeds enemies could sometimes out pace gem projectiles resulting in lost damage.  This could happen even when chilled and cursed so I've reduced how fast enemies are at these higher rounds.

Instead of using a single formula for speed gain, it's now defined on a curve for each level.  This should give me a lot more control over speed if further tweaks are needed.  Even if on a per level basis.

[h1]Line of Sight[/h1]

Some folks were wondering about why on occasion enemies would seemingly ignore their maze to attack the Star Babies. 

Enemies are always looking for targets as they follow the maze you've created.  So if they saw the Star Babies they'd immediately try to engage them. Often this would occur near diagonal walls since it could place an enemy and star baby within range of each other.

Now all gem towers and rocks fully block Line of Sight over their cell so enemies will no longer be able to spot the Star Babies and engage them.  (even if they are near diagonal wall corners)

notes.title: Save System, Achievements, fixes (0.239)
notes.notes:
Hello!

In this update I've added a save/resume system, added some new (hidden) achievements.  And fixed the end game crash (when exiting).  If you encounter any issues please let us know! [url=https://discord.gg/bSgaSk2]Miner Lou Discord[/url]. 

[h1]Saving & Resuming[/h1]

Your progress is automatically saved each round.  You may resume your last played game with the 'Resume' button in the main menu.  This save slot can be cleared by 'Confirming' a level from the level select screen.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

Achievements also have changed and some that were not being tracked properly are now correctly logging things like killing blows, damage dealt, Lou Knockouts etc.  I've also added several new (hidden) achievements.

Level Complete achievements are now only granted upon reaching the end of a level (victory of defeat).  For arcade levels like there are now you must reach at least round 30 to unlock this achievement.  Completing these achievements unlocks the next level as usual.

[h1]Fixes & Changes[/h1]

Miner Lou now uses a new library to communicate with Steam.  This addresses an issue where the client could sometimes crash when exiting the game.

The game should no longer quit and crash, or quit and show the game still running with this change!

notes.title: Crystalarium, Tower Buffs Implemented (0.227)
notes.notes:
Hello, In this update I've added the Crystalarium, Tower Buff Abilities, and a Curse status effect.

[h1]The Crystalarium[/h1]

The Crystalarium is a central place to learn more about gem towers, the Star Babies, stats etc.
Right now it will display all known gem combine recipes.  More additions will be coming to this area with time.  

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790954/7d3f76a1f5c49efefd295c7c2cc8dbca0f8b1911.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790954/ef8c8d79395415228be11fa3c6defc27f49519ea.png[/img][/url]

The Crystalarium is available from the Lobby and in game.

[h1]Tower Buffs Implemented[/h1] 

All Rose Quartz Gems now buff friendly towers around them.  Any tower in range will receive an attack power bonus relative to the attack power of the Quartz tower.  These buff effects stack with each other. 

[h1]Curse Status [/h1]

Amethyst towers now curse enemies they strike reducing their movement speed.  Curse slow stacks with chill.  Slow amount ranges from 10% to 30%.

[h1]Navigation[/h1]

I've made a change to how entities navigate.  This should cause them to automatically recaculate their path if it becomes invalid.  It was possible before to sometimes have Lou or enemies path be interrupted.  This should fix that issue.

As always I appreciate your feedback. [url=https://discord.gg/bSgaSk2]Miner Lou Discord[/url].

notes.title: Tooltips added! (0.216)
notes.notes:
[h1]Tooltips have been added![/h1]
As requested tooltips have been added.  Mousing over an ability or tower's icon will now show a tooltip with a description or name (in the case of the tower icons in a recipe row).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790954/e4937e25bda3d16882011bdeed07721f75651e7d.gif[/img]

[h1]Tower placement change (Leafeater stuck under tower fix)[/h1]
There was an issue where summoned Leafeaters (and possibly Lou) could get trapped under/inside a tower.  This would happen if the player placed a gem right under a leafeater.  This could cause them to get stuck and create targetting issues with enemies.

So now, when a gem is placed- the game will check for player minions or Lou in the gem's cell.  If they are in the same cell the player minions will be warped to a nearby position.  If none are available nearby they are warped to the Star Baby's.

As always I love to hear your feedback and experiences you're having with Miner Lou.   So head on over to the [url=https://discord.gg/bSgaSk2]Miner Lou Discord.[/url]

notes.title: Level 3 and Level 4 available!
notes.notes:
Level 3 and 4 are now available.   These are free additions and will be available once you've completed their previous level's achievements.

The level select screen's text was confusing, so it's been changed to "Previous level not completed".  Originally these levels could not be unlocked but are now available once you've completed the previous level's "Complete" achievement. Which is granted upon reaching round 30 on the previous level.  

Apologies for any confusion over unlocking level 3, it will now unlock and be available as you'd expect once the achievement is completed.

notes.title: Miner Lou update 0.201! Fixes, Additions, Achievements.
notes.notes:
Hello Folks,

I've been busy fixing issues related to player feedback over this past week.  I've added a brightness slider to the setttings screen, updated or changed many achievements, and fixed several bugs in this update.

As always please let us know of any issues or feedback!  [url=https://discord.gg/bSgaSk2]Miner Lou Discord[/url]

[b]Additions:[/b]

Brightness Slider, This slider will increase brightness in game.  Note this is only active in games, not in the lobby/menu screen.

Freebie Score Bonuses - Getting lucky enough to find a combine recipe during the picking phase will now grant you a score bonus.

[b]Fixes:[/b]

Engangement / Combat Fixes
-Leafeaters (the leaf ability summoning) should now properly engage enemies.  
-Leafeaters death animation will now correctly play upon death
-It should now be possible to reliablably summon a max of 3 active leafeaters
-Golems will now properly engage Lou or summons after having knocked out Lou.
-Lou will now properly disengage from enemies after being knocked out. 
-Skellies and Golems should not push Lou around so much in certain situations (usually when trying to run past an already engaged Lou)
-Lou should no longer get stuck and unable to be moved

[b]Achievements changes[/b]
-DPS and killing blows achievements now function properly and are tracked
-Some achievements have been renamed or descriptions changed to better describe their unlock conditions
-All achievement progress has been reset as many achievements have changed
-Completeting level achievements text updated to say "Complete 30 rounds on any difficulty"

Level changes
-Levels are locked until completing the previous level
-Changed the "Requirements not met" message to better reflect the requirements needed

[b]Misc changes[/b]
-Trying to revive a star baby without enough energy (50) now gives a notification.
-Red beam attack shouldn't glitch out anymore
-increased size of the gray outline that appears around picking phase towers.  it should be more visible now
-added more Tips

[b]Balanace changes[/b]
-Heart heal increased from 10 percent of dmg dealt to 15 percent
-Charge cannon range increased from 30m to 38m
-Disco Blizzard's ice nova ability Cooldown reduced from 4secs to 2.5 secs 
-Poison Array poison effect multiplier greatly increased from 0.1 to 0.5

notes.title: Miner Lou Launch!
notes.notes:
It's been a full year of development and Miner Lou is finally ready to launch on Steam!

Leaderboards are active and should be visible from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1047480]Community Hub[/url].

Come join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/bSgaSk2]Miner Lou Discord[/url]. 

I'd really like to stress this is the initial launch of Miner Lou and this is just the beginning.

[h1]Post Launch I'll be focused on developing these areas[/h1]

[list]
[*] Controller Support
[*] Arcade Mode Level Expansion
[*] Party Functionality
[*] Story Mode (in collaboration with silver_swordsman22!)
[/list]

Thank for your interest in Miner Lou.  I look forward to continuing to develop it!  I appreciate the continued support and feedback.  It makes all the difference.
